title: A Day in Their Shoes: Using LLM-Based Perspective-Taking Interactive Fiction to Reduce Stigma Toward Dirty Work

bias_targets.methodology: Pre- and post-intervention assessments using a custom-designed Occupation Stigma Scale, the Inclusion of the Other in the Self (IOS) scale to measure social distance, and empathy/distress scales. Participants were evaluated before and after engaging in an LLM-powered first-person interactive fiction simulation of stigmatized 'dirty work' professions (janitors, firefighters, police officers, and caregivers), supplemented by qualitative semi-structured interviews.
